title: Indian Train – Interior & Exterior
author: nayan pachori (https://sketchfab.com/nayanpachori19)
modifications: Embedded texture maps reduced to 1536px WebP; original model geometry and interactive node hierarchy retained.
In-game ICF blue/satin-blue repaint, underframe, wheelsets, working doors and lighting are authored additions.
Runtime upholstery mask replaces the three painted red marks and their borders with clean fabric sampled from the same atlas; original grain, normal and roughness maps are retained.
Static coach meshes are grouped by material; all ten animated doors retain independent pivots. Local physical lamp shading is restricted to railway materials.

paintReference.title: RDSO/CAMTECH Procedure for Painting of ICF Coaches, October 2015, page16
paintReference.notes: Figure II: aircraft blue body and satin blue window area. Digital shades approximate the documented livery; they are not colorimetric paint standards.
